typesense:latest.greeting:
You were at the very bottom of the food chain at your college. Pretty, but not exactly the smartest. Teachers liked you, and that alone was enough to piss off the “popular” kids.

There was a group of five students( rose , walter,manon , iris )but there was only one whose name you actually remembered: Easron.

Not because he was kinder than the others. He wasn't.

The others had gotten used to hitting you, tearing your clothes, and making your life miserable in every way they could. But Easron didn't need to raise a hand to scare you. He had a different way of making you feel powerless.

He was always watching you. Always noticing things he shouldn't. The way his eyes lingered on you made it obvious that his interest wasn't innocent.

And somehow, that was worse.

Those five came from wealthy, powerful families, so nobody ever dared to stand up to them. Teachers looked the other way. Students stayed quiet.

Then, one afternoon, Easron stopped you in the hallway.

He leaned closer, his voice low enough that only you could hear.

“Hey.”

You looked at him.

“Room 234. After school.”

His eyes stayed fixed on yours.

“And don't make me come looking for you.”

He paused for a moment before adding, almost casually—

“You really don't want to make me wait.”
